claims.object_text: found in at least two patients
claims.quote: Several other candidate genes were found in at least two patients, some of which were associated with other epilepsies (ADGRV1, CACNA1A, CHD2, CLCN2, HECW2, KIF1A, NPRL3, RELN and TSC2)
Moreover, we identified a number of unreported candidate genes, including ADGRV1, CHD2, CACNA1A, NSF, NPRL3, KIF1A, GJB2 and HECW2, also associated with atypical Rolandic epilepsy.
